name: A season's baselines
description: Admin only: every baseline uploaded into a season, oldest first -- in play, admitted and out of play, still being admitted, and the uploads admission refused with the word it refused them for, because an admin re-uploading a baseline needs to know why the last one did not take. A baseline is a `baseline.` account, its entry and its version in this season, and its STATUS is whether it is in play: `active` is, `disabled` is not, `testing` is being admitted and `rejected` was refused. The ladder already shows the ones in play to everyone, under the baseline mark; this list is the admin's, because an upload still being admitted, or refused, is nobody else's business.

with.name: Admins only
with.description: The role is read off the live session rather than off a claim in the cookie, so revoking a session or demoting a user takes effect on the next request.
